output.text:
# Reading list on OAuth

The best single explainer is the IETF overview at https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6749 and the PKCE extension at https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7636.

A diagram of the flow: ![flow](https://example.com/oauth-flow.png)

Key points: tokens are short-lived; refresh tokens must be stored safely; PKCE binds the authorization code to the client that asked for it.

steps.output: This is a short reading list on OAuth, written for developers who want the primary sources on the protocol. It points to two IETF documents, the OAuth 2.0 framework (RFC 6749) and the PKCE extension (RFC 7636), links a diagram of the flow, and closes with three key points: tokens are short-lived, refresh tokens must be stored safely, and PKCE binds the authorization code to the client that asked for it. It is a single Markdown page of a few lines, and the diagram is a link to an image rather than part of the file.
